8.3.4.2.9 Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords
[SWS_Dem_91191] Definition of API function Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrame
Records ⌈
Service Name
Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords (
uint8 ClientId,
uint16* NumberOfFilteredRecords
)
Service ID [hex]
0x5a
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different ClientIds, non reentrant for the same ClientId.
Parameters (in)
ClientId
Unique client id, assigned to the instance of the calling module.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
NumberOfFiltered
Records
Number of all freeze frame records currently stored in the primary
event memory.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
Status of the operation
E_OK: Returned correctly the number of freeze frame records
DEM_PENDING: The requested value is calculated
asynchronously and currently not available. The caller can retry
later
Description
This function returns the number of all freeze frame records currently stored in the primary
event memory
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
